message.title: New Share Capital Registered
message.body:
Ålesund, 7 August 2026: 

Reference is made to the previous stock exchange announcements published by Golden Energy Offshore Services ASA regarding the capital reduction by way of reducing the par value of each of the company’s shares from NOK 8.00 to NOK 1.00. The share capital reduction has today been registered with the Norwegian Register of Business Enterprises.
 
The company’s registered share capital is NOK 70 709 494 divided into 70 709 494 shares, each with a nominal value of NOK 1.00.

For further information, please contact:

Per Ivar Fagervoll 
CEO
pif@geoff.no 
Mobile: + 47 974 28 884

This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations and section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
